$comment: UPSTREAM IMAGE MIRROR MANIFEST — the SINGLE source of truth for every
third-party container image a Loom DEPLOY PATH pulls (issue #2682, FINISHLINE D14).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The mirror used to live as a hard-coded bash array in
TWO workflows (full-app-deploy-commercial.yml and gov-provision-dataplane-images.yml)
with the bicep refs written a third time in the modules. Three copies of the same
fact drift: bump `airflowImage` in bicep and the ACR never receives that tag, so the
Container App points at an image that does not exist and cannot activate a revision.
Nothing observed that. Now the workflows READ this file (scripts/ci/mirror-upstream-images.sh)
and scripts/ci/check-upstream-image-mirror.mjs FAILS the build when a bicep-pinned ref
has no entry here, when an entry has no digest, or when a workflow stops using the
shared script.
DIGEST PINNING (never float a tag). `az acr import` copies whatever the upstream tag
points at TODAY. A Docker Hub tag is mutable, so a tag-sourced mirror can silently
change the bits under a reviewed licence and a passed CVE scan. Every entry therefore
carries the resolved multi-arch manifest digest and the import runs against
`<registry>/<repo>@<digest>`, tagging the result in ACR as `<acrRepo>:<tag>` so the
bicep ref stays human-readable and stable. To move to a new upstream version: bump
`tag` AND `digest` together (resolve with scripts/ci/resolve-upstream-digest.sh), bump
the bicep ref, re-review the licence in check-license-inventory.mjs.
The `acrRepo:tag` MUST be byte-identical to the repo:tag written in the consuming
bicep module, because the module composes the effective ref as
`${acrLoginServer}/${repo}:${tag}`.
BUILD-TIME vs DEPLOY-TIME. This manifest covers DEPLOY-time pulls only — images a
running Container App / Container Apps Job pulls from a registry. Images an
apps/*/Dockerfile builds FROM are pulled server-side by `az acr build` inside Azure
during the image build, are baked into a Loom-owned image, and are covered by LIC0
(REVIEWED_IMAGES) + the base-image CVE gate. They are inventoried in
docs/fiab/deployment/upstream-image-mirror.md and tracked separately.

consumers: platform/fiab/bicep/modules/admin-plane/airflow.bicep (airflowImage) — OSS Airflow host, default-ON wherever postgresQuotaAvailable is true
